verdict.rationale: Cake documents a separate My Cake Portal where investors and employees see their own holdings, while the admin controls what they can see and they never get the full cap table. Linked share certificates are also available in that portal, and stakeholder portals come even on the free plan, so investors can self-serve their holdings instead of emailing the founder. Investor communication is mentioned only once, as 'communicate with your investors' inside the capital-raise workflow, so structured updates are thinly evidenced. Missing for 10: documented structured investor-update features (e.g. periodic update templates or notifications to investors), independent or hands-on corroboration of the portal experience.
